program:
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (10e-6, 4e-6, 20e-6),   # core branch current at 27C (PTAT)
    "kptat":  (0.50, 0.40, 0.60),     # I*R2 [V] PTAT term added to Veb3
    "gmid_p": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS current sources / OTA load density
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmid_n": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # OTA input pair (weak inversion -> low Vgs)
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "It":     (4e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),    # OTA tail current
    "Rs":     (10e3, 2e3, 30e3),      # equal series R lifting OTA input CM
    "Cc":     (3e-12, 1e-12, 10e-12), # dominant-pole / PSRR cap vg->vdd
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    I, It = p["I"], p["It"]
    lnN = math.log(N)
    R1 = UT * lnN / I
    R2 = p["kptat"] / I

    # PMOS current sources (core A, core B, vref branch)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.6)
    # OTA PMOS load: same density as mp -> diode voltage == required vg (no systematic offset)
    ml = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=mp.vgs)
    # tail-bias PMOS (mirror of vg)
    mt = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], It, vds=0.9)
    # OTA NMOS input pair
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], It / 2, vds=0.25)
    # tail current source + its diode reference
    mtail = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, It, vds=0.25)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # ---- core branches ----
    n.dev("MPA", "va", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RSA", "va", "ea", p["Rs"])
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=1)

    n.dev("MPB", "vb", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RSB", "vb", "xb", p["Rs"])
    n.R("R1", "xb", "eb", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "eb", m=N)

    # ---- output branch ----
    n.dev("MPC", "vref", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)

    # ---- error OTA: (+)=vb (diode side), (-)=va (output side), out=vg ----
    n.dev("MNA", "d1", "vb", "tail", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MNB", "vg", "va", "tail", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MLA", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", ml)
    n.dev("MLB", "vg", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", ml)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", mtail)
    # self-biased tail reference
    n.dev("M6", "nb", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mt)
    n.dev("M7", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mtail)

    # ---- compensation / PSRR ----
    n.C("CC", "vg", "vdd", p["Cc"])

    # ---- start-up: vref low -> s high -> MS1 pulls vg low ----
    n.M("MW", "s", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)   # weak pull-up (~<1uA)
    n.M("MS2", "s", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 0.5) # strong pull-down when vref up
    n.M("MS1", "vg", "s", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)   # start-up kick

    # ---- predictions ----
    veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I / 10e-6)
    vref = veb + p["kptat"]
    i_tot = 3 * I * (398.0 / 300.0) + 2 * It * 1.3 + 1e-6
    power = 1.98 * i_tot
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": 25.0, "power": power, "startup_ok": 1,
               "line_reg": 5e-3, "psrr_1k": -50.0}
